headlines.title: Fed holds interest rates for a seventh-consecutive month, underscoring inflation concerns
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve left its key interest rate unchanged for the seventh month despite concerns about inflation that continues to pressure U.S. households.

headlines.title: Dr. Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment over 100 times during Senate hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci invoked his Fifth Amendment right 106 times during a Senate hearing on the Covid pandemic response. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports on the questions Fauci was asked and his opening statement saying Sen. Rand Paul, R-Ky., has an "unhinged obsession" with him.

headlines.title: Jared Leto accused of criminal sexual conduct
headlines.description: Multiple women accused actor and musician Jared Leto of criminal sexual conduct in a new BBC documentary. In a statement, Leto responded that he has “never sexually assaulted anyone.” NBC News' Chloe Melas reports.

headlines.title: Trump’s IRS carveout threatens to hold up Todd Blanche attorney general nomination
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — Todd Blanche’s path to confirmation as the next attorney general of the United States faced a setback Wednesday as two key Republicans pressed the Justice Department to commit in writing to kill an “anti-weaponization” fund that could give money to Trump allies and restrict the scope of the tax audit immunity given to the president and his family members.

headlines.title: France Orders 4,000 More to Evacuate Amid New Heat Wave
headlines.description: Authorities in France have ordered 4,000 more people to evacuate from its tourist sites along its Atlantic coast, as returning heat threatens to erase the gains of firefighters. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY from France.

headlines.title: Fauci testifies before the Senate on the Covid pandemic
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as Dr. Anthony Fauci testifies before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee as part of Committee Chairman Rand Paul's investigation into the origins of Covid. Lawmakers are expected to question Fauci about what he knew and didn't know as the pandemic was unfolding.

headlines.title: Mia Bieniemy, wife of Kansas City Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy allegedly shot by their son, out of ICU
headlines.description: The wife of Kansas City Chiefs offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy, who was wounded Sunday night in a shooting inside the couple’s Northern Virginia home, was moved out of intensive care, Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Wednesday.

headlines.title: Trump announces plans for sprawling Dulles Airport makeover
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced a makeover of Dulles International Airport, including construction of terminals and the removal of the airport’s aging shuttles.

headlines.title: K-pop group BTS won’t submit its music for Grammy Awards
headlines.description: K-pop band BTS said that it will not submit its music for consideration at the 2027 Grammy Awards, citing concerns over category divisions.

headlines.title: Anthony Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment right not to testify at Covid hearing
headlines.description: Dr. Anthony Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions at a contentious hearing Wednesday on the origins of Covid and the government’s handling of the pandemic, saying he would invoke his Fifth Amendment right to avoid the possibility that Republicans use his testimony to prosecute him for perjury.

headlines.title: Deodorant for kids: Derms talk the right age for deodorant and the best ones for young skin
headlines.description: Kids are hitting puberty earlier — and needing deodorant sooner. Dermatologists share the best kids’ deodorants for sensitive skin, plus when and how kids should start using them.
